howto.what: Claude 会先搜索可用的 All Images AI 工具，检查连接状态，然后根据你的指令执行图片生成、编辑等操作。
howto.when: 当你要求生成、编辑或处理图片，或提到 All Images AI 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 All Images AI 生成一张夕阳下的海滩图片。
用 All Images AI 将这张照片转成油画风格。
say.note: Claude 会使用该工具进行风格转换。

say.text: 检查我的 All Images AI 连接是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会运行连接检查流程。

howto.what_en: Claude will first search for available All Images AI tools, check connection status, then execute image generation, editing, or other operations based on your request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate, edit, or process images, or mention All Images AI.

say_en.text: Use All Images AI to generate a sunset beach picture.
say_en.note: Claude calls All Images AI tools to generate an image.

say_en.text: Convert this photo to oil painting style with All Images AI.
say_en.note: Claude uses the tool for style transfer.

say_en.text: Check my All Images AI connection status.
say_en.note: Claude runs the connection verification workflow.
